I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on m

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application public URL or host settings rather than falling back to localhost when PUBLIC_URL is unset, ensuring password reset links point to the correct production or staging domain.
args.title: Use configured public URL instead of localhost in password reset links
